selection_rule: Three 5-Hz grid frames near 25%, 50%, and 75% of the source-bracketed selected point, using the closest earlier frame at a tie. Select on source time, not measured detector error; retain unreadable, occluded, or airborne slots as null.
blinding_limit: The rule was fixed after a three-frame raw detector spot check. Any later shoe marks are unblinded supplementary reference and must not be described as independent held-out ground truth.
requested_measurement: Visible grounded midpoint of the apparent shoe contact locations, clicked in unboxed source frames. Mark null with physical-state reason otherwise.
calibration_dependency: Projected position discrepancies can be calculated only after the separate court-mark review has a usable four-corner transform.
addendum_note: USC?BYU frames were chosen by source time within the separately added source-bracketed point, after a raw detector spot check but before player-position error measurement. The original two-case reference plan remains unchanged.
